verdict.rationale: Ramp documents OAuth 2.0 with granular, least-privilege scopes (transactions:read, cards:read_vault, treasury:read, etc.) explicitly recommended via 'configure only the scopes your app needs,' plus an agent-specific identity model (agents.ramp.com) with per-agent keys tied to a human sponsor, flexible read/act permissions, auto-expiring cards, and separate human/agent credential storage in the CLI. A live probe confirms the production MCP server is OAuth-gated and enumerates dozens of granular scopes, corroborating the docs. Missing for 10: no independent third-party audit of scope enforcement or hands-on report of restricting an agent's credentials in practice.
